prompts.urban: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen mobile app welcome background, portrait 1024 by 1536. Create an original polished 3D animated children's storybook illustration of a warm, welcoming small town called the world of SCALA, without any written words. A sunlit pedestrian plaza bordered by pastel coral, honey-yellow and peach homes, rounded windows and flower boxes, green trees, a winding cream-colored path leading toward an inviting community house with a small blue door. Sunny sky, soft clouds, golden morning light, detailed charming rounded forms and rich but gentle color. Composition: foliage and architecture frame the left, right and bottom edges; large quiet light warm-sky space across the upper and middle center for overlaying an existing brand logo and welcome UI, keeping it unobstructed. Use luminous natural materials, soft dimensional shading, child-friendly theatrical depth, high quality illustration for ages 6 to 12. No characters, no traffic, no signage, no logos, no lettering, no laurels, no four-point star motifs, no interface or borders.
prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production icon atlas for a Spanish children's educational mobile application, a square 4 by 4 grid of SIXTEEN separate 3D toy icons, true transparent background, no words or labels. Every icon is centered in its equal-sized square cell with generous transparent padding, nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cohesive premium 3D clay-and-gloss toy style, rounded friendly forms, softly lit dimensional shading, subtle highlights, vivid coral, golden honey, soft emerald and lilac accents. Exact left-to-right row order: Row 1: a plump coral red heart; a beautiful open golden storybook with colorful pages; a round golden-yellow mischievous smiling face with raised eyebrows, friendly not sinister; two welcoming hands gently holding a small pink heart. Row 2: three happy childlike faces together representing friendship; a rounded cozy little community house with a blue door; a beautiful chunky purple settings gear with a honey center; a warm smiling golden sun. Row 3: a rounded emerald play triangle; a plump emerald check mark; a warm golden curved back arrow; a cute honey-colored padlock. Row 4: a coral-and-gold loudspeaker; a colorful gift box tied with a soft ribbon; a peaceful smiling yellow face with closed eyes; a gentle peach speech bubble containing a tiny pink heart. Avoid leaves, wreaths, laurels, crosses inside shields, four-point stars, gemstones, metallic sharpness, borders, labels, lettering, interface panels. Child-friendly and legible at 48 pixels. The background must be fully transparent, preserving each icon's isolated soft drop shadow.
